_about: Fill this file once. Every 'FILL' must be replaced before the first run; the script stops and lists what is still missing. README.md explains each field; examples/ has three filled-in configs (Eilat, Jerusalem, New York).

name.en: FILL: e.g. Chabad of Your Town

friday.evidence: Default taken from the Eilat rule (RULES.md, rule 1) without its 19:00 summer cap. Change it to your own.

shabbat.evidence: Default taken from the Eilat rule (RULES.md, rule 2) without its 18:45 cap. Change it to your own.

weekdays.evidence: Carried from last week's approved message; set 'initial' to today's time, or replace with a 'fixed' or 'rule'. A tested rule from Eilat: {"from": "sunset_sun", "offset": -25, "round_to": 15, "round": "down", "hold": {"duration": 25, "end_within": 5}} (see RULES.md, rule 4).

elul.he: כתיבה וחתימה טובה לשנה טובה ומתוקה

weekly_thought.audience: a traditional Jew with no background in Chassidus
sources: the shliach's own notebook of the Rebbe's Torah
